warnings: OpenFootball lacks 20 Matchday 38 scores. All 20 are instead independently matched by football-data.org, so they are two-source verified but not three-source verified.

OpenFootball and football-data.org both report an incorrect 3-0 half-time score for Fiorentina vs Inter on 2025-02-06. Football-Data.co.uk reports 0-0, and Inter's official match centre confirms 0-0 at half time with all three goals scored in the second half.

official_resolutions.reason: The official timeline states half time was 0-0 and lists all three goals in the second half.
